newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: THREE SHIPS WITH 39,155 T SUGAR REACH KARACHI.
newsitem.headline: THREE SHIPS WITH 39,155 T SUGAR REACH KARACHI.

text.p: At least three ships with 39,155 tonnes of sugar have reached Karachi port and are likely to be unloaded in the next few days, a port official said on Friday.
The vessel Tong Jian with 12,155 tonnes of sugar is likely to unload on Friday/Saturday, the official said.
The Won San with 14,000 tonnes and the Nan Jiang with 13,000 tonnes are likely to discharge in the next few days, he said.
Sugar importers booked more than 100,000 tonnes of sugar before the end of fiscal 1996/97 on June 30, one dealer said.
There was no immediate confirmation of this figure from the All Pakistan Sugar Mills Association.
The Association says production by its mills for the financial year had reached 2.393 million tonnes by June 30 compared to 2.47 million tonnes at the same time a year ago.
